summary: Short residential kerb, homes 14 m away on the same side.
reasons: Houses 14 m away on own side
Quiet residential street, cars park here
Only 10 m of kerb, beside a driveway

best_section.where: Todd Street north kerb, beside the driveway just before the bend

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 14 m away on the same side and more across the road; no bush or park behind.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park on the kerb in both images; a van fits at the kerb but the 10 m stretch is tight beside a driveway.
drivers.convention: A few cars park along the street, so a van would not look odd, but residents will notice it.

flags: Driveway beside the section, do not block it
sun_shade: Open to sun; trees on the north side shade it a little in the morning.
